_README: EVERY entry carries a `recall` field describing how the sequence got
here. `recall` is NOT a measure of how good the zipper is -- it says how
much you should trust that the letters below match the cited paper:
high   - widely reproduced sequence, but still worth a 30-second check
medium - verify against the cited reference before ordering anything
None of these were copied from a database by the program that wrote this
file. Check them against the primary reference before any experiment.
To extend the library, append entries or point --library at your own
JSON or FASTA file. Designed orthogonal sets worth adding by hand:
SYNZIP1-23 (Thompson et al. 2012, ACS Synth Biol 1:118), the Woolfson
lab CC-Di/CC-Tri series, and the Keating lab bZIP coiled-coil array.

zippers.name: GCN4-p1
zippers.note: Canonical parallel homodimer. Asn16 at an 'a' position enforces the dimer and parallel orientation.

zippers.name: c-Jun-LZ
zippers.note: Forms both homodimers and the much more stable heterodimer with Fos.

zippers.name: c-Fos-LZ
zippers.note: Acidic; cannot homodimerise appreciably, so it is obligately heterodimeric with Jun.

zippers.name: Acid-p1
zippers.note: 'Peptide Velcro' acidic strand; glutamates at e/g positions block homodimerisation.

zippers.name: Base-p1
zippers.note: 'Peptide Velcro' basic strand; pairs with Acid-p1 through g<->e' salt bridges.
